FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_WarehouseShuttle_SupercapTraction
(*
========================================================================================================================
  PROJECT       : HIGH-SPEED AUTOMATED STORAGE AND RETRIEVAL SYSTEM (AS/RS TIER-TO-TIER 2D/3D SHUTTLE)
  SUBSYSTEM     : SUPERCAPACITOR RAIL IN-MOTION FAST CHARGING & ANTI-SLIP ACCELERATION VECTORING
  DESIGNATION   : SIL-2 / IEC 62061 DUAL-DRIVE CYBER-PHYSICAL TRACTION & ENERGY MANAGEMENT CONTROLLER
  SPECIFICATION : IEC 61131-3 3RD EDITION / ISA-88 MODULAR STATE MACHINE / ISA-18.2 ALARM ENGINE
  AUTHOR        : PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (LUMINA AI SWARM)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CYBER-PHYSICAL THEORETICAL FORMULATION & MATHEMATICAL GOVERNING DYNAMICS:

  1. SUPERCAPACITOR IN-MOTION FAST CHARGING ELECTRODYNAMICS & THERMAL RELAXATION:
     The shuttle onboard electrical energy storage system (EESS) comprises an Electric Double-Layer Capacitor (EDLC)
     module with nominal bank capacitance C_bank = 165.0 F, rated voltage V_nom = 96.0 V, internal DC equivalent
     series resistance ESR_dc = 12.5 mOhm. In-motion energy ingestion occurs when the shuttle traverses energized track
     sections equipped with dual top-mounted copper-beryllium conductor rails (80.0 V - 120.0 V DC bus).
     Dynamic terminal behavior follows a fractional-diffusion Randles-equivalent network:
         V_cap(t) = V_ocv(SoC) + I_cap(t) * ESR_dc + V_polarization(t)
         d(SoC)/dt = - (I_cap(t) / (C_bank * V_nom)) * 100.0   [%/s]
         P_joule(t) = (I_cap(t))^2 * ESR_dc                    [W]
         d(T_cell)/dt = (P_joule - h_conv * A_surf * (T_cell - T_amb)) / (M_cell * C_thermal)
     Dynamic fast charging is modulated via a high-frequency synchronous bidirectional buck-boost converter. To prevent
     arcing and destructive electro-erosion during contact shoe departure, a look-ahead predictive ramp-down algorithm
     quenches charge current down to zero within 25.0 ms of rail departure detection.

  2. LONGITUDINAL WHEEL-RAIL ADHESION DYNAMICS & ANTI-SLIP TORQUE VECTORING (ASR/TCS):
     Shuttle gross mass varies widely based on payload status (empty tare ~120.0 kg vs. heavy carton ~250.0 kg).
     Normal force per axle is dynamically redistributed by longitudinal load transfer during high acceleration:
         F_normal_front = 0.5 * m_total * g - (h_cg / L_wheelbase) * m_total * a_x
         F_normal_rear  = 0.5 * m_total * g + (h_cg / L_wheelbase) * m_total * a_x
     Longitudinal wheel slip ratios for independent Left and Right polyurethane-coated drive wheels:
         lambda_L = (v_wheel_L - v_ground) / MAX(ABS(v_wheel_L), ABS(v_ground), 0.05)
         lambda_R = (v_wheel_R - v_ground) / MAX(ABS(v_wheel_R), ABS(v_ground), 0.05)
     Traction adherence follows the non-linear Burckhardt-Pacejka formulation:
         mu(lambda) = c1 * (1.0 - EXP(-c2 * lambda)) - c3 * lambda
     Optimal adhesion occurs at lambda_opt in [0.05 .. 0.08]. If wheel slip exceeds threshold lambda_crit = 0.11,
     micro-slip divergence triggers dynamic torque vectoring:
         T_L_cmd = 0.5 * T_target - Delta_T_vector - K_slip * (lambda_L - lambda_opt)
         T_R_cmd = 0.5 * T_target + Delta_T_vector - K_slip * (lambda_R - lambda_opt)

  3. DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE TRACTION CONTROL (MPC):
     Formulated in discrete state-space with sampling period dt = 5.0 ms (T_sample = 0.005 s):
         x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] + E_d * d[k]
         y[k]   = C_d * x[k]
     State vector:
         x[0] = Position error along rail axis: e_s = s_ref - s_voted       [m]
         x[1] = Longitudinal velocity error:   e_v = v_ref - v_voted       [m/s]
         x[2] = Integral velocity error:        e_v_int                     [m]
         x[3] = Supercapacitor SoC error:       e_soc = SoC_ref - SoC_est   [%]
     Control inputs:
         u[0] = Total commanded tractive force F_trac                      [N]
         u[1] = Commanded in-motion charging current I_chg                 [A]
     Constrained optimization enforces actuator ceilings:
         |F_trac| <= mu_est * m_total * g
         |a_x|    <= 4.50 m/s2,  |jerk| <= 25.0 m/s3

  4. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR FUSION ENGINE:
     Ground speed is validated via 3 independent sensing channels:
         Ch 1: Time-of-Flight (TOF) Optical Laser Doppler Distance Derivative [m/s]
         Ch 2: Left Traction Motor High-Resolution Optical Encoder [m/s]
         Ch 3: Right Traction Motor High-Resolution Optical Encoder [m/s]
     Dynamic cross-channel validation isolates single-wheel slip divergence, laser dropouts, and encoder phase loss,
     dynamically degrading across 2oo3 -> 2oo2 -> 1oo1 -> Degraded Creep / Limp-Home Mode.
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Master Permissives and Hardware Safety Circuits --- *)
    bMasterEnable               : BOOL;     (* Shuttle system master run permissive [TRUE = Active] *)
    bSafetyRelayOk              : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 dual-channel emergency stop circuit [TRUE = Healthy] *)
    bAutoModeSelect             : BOOL;     (* Mode selection [TRUE = Autonomous Dispatch, FALSE = Manual / Test] *)

    (* --- Supervisory Kinematic Trajectory Targets --- *)
    rTargetVelocity_ms          : REAL;     (* Trajectory reference velocity setpoint [m/s] (-6.0 .. 6.0) *)
    rTargetPosition_m           : REAL;     (* Rail axis absolute target destination coordinate [m] (0.0 .. 500.0) *)
    rTargetAcceleration_ms2     : REAL;     (* Planned trajectory longitudinal acceleration [m/s2] (0.0 .. 5.0) *)

    (* --- Redundant Kinematic Feedback Instrumentation (2oo3 TMR) --- *)
    rLaserDistVelocity_ms       : REAL;     (* TMR Channel 1: Optical laser Doppler ground velocity [m/s] *)
    rWheelEncoderLeft_ms        : REAL;     (* TMR Channel 2: Left driven wheel surface velocity [m/s] *)
    rWheelEncoderRight_ms       : REAL;     (* TMR Channel 3: Right driven wheel surface velocity [m/s] *)
    rImuAccel_X_ms2             : REAL;     (* Longitudinal dynamic acceleration from chassis 6-DOF IMU [m/s2] *)

    (* --- Mechanical Dynamics & Rail Interface Parameters --- *)
    rTotalShuttleMass_kg        : REAL;     (* Gross mass (tare chassis + tote payload) [kg] (120.0 .. 260.0) *)
    rRailFrictionNominal_mu     : REAL;     (* Baseline dry rail static friction coefficient [-] (0.20 .. 0.65) *)

    (* --- Supercapacitor Bank Instrumentation & In-Motion Power Rail --- *)
    rSupercapVoltage_V          : REAL;     (* Supercapacitor bank terminal voltage [V] (40.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rSupercapCurrent_A          : REAL;     (* Supercapacitor net current [A] (Positive = Discharge, Negative = Influx) *)
    rSupercapCellMaxTemp_DegC   : REAL;     (* Peak individual supercapacitor cell temperature [deg C] (Max: 65.0) *)
    rChargingRailBusVoltage_V   : REAL;     (* In-motion charging rail conductor supply voltage [V] (75.0 .. 125.0) *)
    bChargeShoeContactActive    : BOOL;     (* Pneumatic sliding collector shoe contact verified flag [TRUE = Closed] *)
    bChargeRailZoneApproach     : BOOL;     (* Track RFID/Optical tag detecting upcoming charging rail sector *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Subsystem Status and Operational Flags --- *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Shuttle traction & fast-charging system healthy and armed *)
    bTractionSlipActive         : BOOL;     (* Wheel slip mitigation / torque derating algorithm active *)
    bFastChargeActive           : BOOL;     (* In-motion high-current supercapacitor charging in progress *)
    bDegradedMode               : BOOL;     (* Operating in sensor degraded or thermal derated fallback *)

    (* --- Dynamic Actuator Commands --- *)
    rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm           : REAL;     (* Torque setpoint command for Left PMSM traction drive [Nm] (-45.0 .. 45.0) *)
    rTorqueCmdRight_Nm          : REAL;     (* Torque setpoint command for Right PMSM traction drive [Nm] (-45.0 .. 45.0) *)
    rChargeCurrentCmd_A         : REAL;     (* Buck-boost DC-DC fast charging current setpoint [A] (0.0 .. 350.0) *)
    rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct     : REAL;     (* Electromechanical failsafe brake release command [%] (100.0 = Released) *)

    (* --- Physical Estimates and Validated Process Variables --- *)
    rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct : REAL;     (* Real-time supercapacitor State-of-Charge [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rVotedGroundSpeed_ms        : REAL;     (* Triple-modular-redundant resolved chassis true ground speed [m/s] *)
    rTractionForceTotal_N       : REAL;     (* Total commanded tractive effort along travel direction [N] *)
    rEstimatedAdhesion_mu       : REAL;     (* Real-time dynamic wheel-rail adhesion coefficient [-] *)
    rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio        : REAL;     (* Real-time normalized slip ratio on Left drive wheel [-] *)
    rWheelSlipRight_Ratio       : REAL;     (* Real-time normalized slip ratio on Right drive wheel [-] *)

    (* --- ISA-18.2 Diagnostics and Status Words --- *)
    wAlarmWord                  : WORD;     (* Packed alarm word: Bit0=E-Stop, Bit1=SlipRunaway, Bit2=Overtemp, etc. *)
    wStatusWord                 : WORD;     (* Subsystem operational state and control loop status word *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- Finite State Machine Supervisory Registers (ISA-88) --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Active operational state index *)
    iPreviousState              : INT := 0; (* Previous execution cycle state index *)

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Kinematic Voter Registers --- *)
    bSensorLaser_Valid          : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensorLeft_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensorRight_Valid          : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthySensorCount         : INT  := 3;
    rTmrTolerance_ms            : REAL := 0.28; (* Maximum permissible inter-channel velocity divergence [m/s] *)
    rDelta_Laser_Left           : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta_Laser_Right          : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta_Left_Right           : REAL := 0.0;

    (* --- State-Space Discrete Plant Matrices (Sampling Period dt = 0.005 s) --- *)
    (* Discretized state equations: x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k]
         x[0] = Position error (m)
         x[1] = Ground velocity error (m/s)
         x[2] = Velocity error integral accumulator (m)
         x[3] = Supercap SoC deviation (%)
    *)
    rState_x0_PosErr            : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x1_VelErr            : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x2_VelErrInt         : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x3_SocErr            : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Linearized Matrix Coefficients *)
    rA00 : REAL := 1.0000;  rA01 : REAL := -0.0050; rA02 : REAL := 0.0000;
    rA10 : REAL := 0.0000;  rA11 : REAL := 0.9850;  rA12 : REAL := 0.0000;
    rA20 : REAL := 0.0000;  rA21 : REAL := 0.0050;  rA22 : REAL := 1.0000;
    rA33 : REAL := 0.9992;  (* Natural self-discharge / coulombic retention *)

    rB10 : REAL := 0.0000416; (* Velocity sensitivity per Newton tractive force: dt / m_total *)
    rB31 : REAL := 0.00315;   (* SoC sensitivity per Ampere charging current: (dt / (C * V)) * 100 *)

    (* Model Predictive Horizon Gains & Optimal Control Weights *)
    rGain_PosP                  : REAL := 1250.0;  (* Proportional position tracking stiffness [N/m] *)
    rGain_VelD                  : REAL := 680.0;   (* Velocity damping feedback gain [N/(m/s)] *)
    rGain_VelI                  : REAL := 85.0;    (* Integral steady-state tracking gain [N/m] *)
    rPredictedForce_N           : REAL := 0.0;     (* Raw unconstrained MPC force command [N] *)

    (* --- Wheel Adhesion & Anti-Slip Vectoring Parameters --- *)
    rWheelRadius_m              : REAL := 0.0625;  (* Drive wheel rolling radius [m] (125 mm diameter) *)
    rGearRatio                  : REAL := 4.25;    (* Planetary reducer gear ratio *)
    rSlipThreshold_Warning      : REAL := 0.065;   (* Micro-slip optimal boundary *)
    rSlipThreshold_Critical     : REAL := 0.110;   (* Critical slip runaway limit *)
    rTorqueVectorBias_Nm        : REAL := 0.0;     (* Differential torque bias for yaw / slip correction [Nm] *)
    rAdhesionFilter_mu          : REAL := 0.45;    (* Filtered real-time adhesion coefficient *)
    rMaxTractionForce_N         : REAL := 0.0;     (* Adhesion-limited maximum available tractive force [N] *)

    (* --- Supercapacitor Electrochemical & Thermal Watchdogs --- *)
    rCapacitance_F              : REAL := 165.0;   (* Nominal bank capacitance [F] *)
    rSupercapESR_Ohm            : REAL := 0.0125;  (* Dynamic equivalent series resistance [Ohm] *)
    rCoulombCounter_As          : REAL := 15840.0; (* Stored electrical charge accumulator [A*s] *)
    rSoC_Target_Pct             : REAL := 92.0;    (* Target float charge State-of-Charge [%] *)
    rDynamicCurrentLimit_A      : REAL := 300.0;   (* Thermally de-rated fast charging current limit [A] *)

    (* --- Timers and Discrete Filtering Blocks --- *)
    tonStartupDelay             : TON;             (* Power-up hardware stabilization timer *)
    tonShoeDebounce             : TON;             (* Shoe engagement contact bounce filter *)
    tonSlipLatching             : TON;             (* Slip event persistence integrator *)
    tonChargeRampDown           : TON;             (* Shoe departure anti-arcing pre-ramp timer *)

    (* --- System Cycle Counters & Diagnostics --- *)
    udiExecutionCycles          : UDINT := 0;      (* Cyclic loop counter *)
    udiSlipInterventionsCount   : UDINT := 0;      (* Cumulative anti-slip active events *)
    rCumulativeEnergyCharged_Wh : REAL := 0.0;     (* Total cumulative ingested energy [W*h] *)
    rCumulativeTractionWork_kJ  : REAL := 0.0;     (* Total mechanical tractive work expended [kJ] *)
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC ALGORITHMIC EXECUTION PIPELINE (SAMPLING TIME dt = 0.005 s / 200 Hz TASK RATE)
========================================================================================================================
*)

udiExecutionCycles := udiExecutionCycles + 1;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY CIRCUIT INTEGRITY & IMMEDIATE FIRST-OUT TRIP LATCHING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bSafetyRelayOk THEN
    (* Immediate deterministic fail-safe dynamic braking & electromechanical brake clamp *)
    bSystemReady                := FALSE;
    bTractionSlipActive         := FALSE;
    bFastChargeActive           := FALSE;
    bDegradedMode               := FALSE;
    rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm           := 0.0;
    rTorqueCmdRight_Nm          := 0.0;
    rChargeCurrentCmd_A         := 0.0;
    rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct     := 0.0;   (* De-energize coil to drop spring-loaded holding brake *)
    rTractionForceTotal_N       := 0.0;

    wAlarmWord.0                := TRUE;  (* Emergency Stop Loop Interrupted Alarm *)
    wStatusWord                 := 16#F001;
    iState                      := 99;    (* Transition directly to Emergency Safety Brake state *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wAlarmWord.0 := FALSE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR FUSION ENGINE FOR GROUND SPEED
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify signal physical boundary plausibility [-7.0 .. 7.0 m/s] *)
bSensorLaser_Valid := (rLaserDistVelocity_ms >= -7.0) AND (rLaserDistVelocity_ms <= 7.0);
bSensorLeft_Valid  := (rWheelEncoderLeft_ms >= -7.0)  AND (rWheelEncoderLeft_ms <= 7.0);
bSensorRight_Valid := (rWheelEncoderRight_ms >= -7.0) AND (rWheelEncoderRight_ms <= 7.0);

(* Compute Inter-Channel Discrepancies *)
rDelta_Laser_Left  := ABS(rLaserDistVelocity_ms - rWheelEncoderLeft_ms);
rDelta_Laser_Right := ABS(rLaserDistVelocity_ms - rWheelEncoderRight_ms);
rDelta_Left_Right  := ABS(rWheelEncoderLeft_ms - rWheelEncoderRight_ms);

(* Execute 2oo3 Voting Logic with Sensor Anomaly Rejection *)
IF bSensorLaser_Valid AND bSensorLeft_Valid AND bSensorRight_Valid THEN
    IF (rDelta_Laser_Left <= rTmrTolerance_ms) AND (rDelta_Laser_Right <= rTmrTolerance_ms) AND (rDelta_Left_Right <= rTmrTolerance_ms) THEN
        (* Complete 3-channel consensus: True ground speed is weighted average favoring optical laser Doppler *)
        rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := (0.50 * rLaserDistVelocity_ms) + (0.25 * rWheelEncoderLeft_ms) + (0.25 * rWheelEncoderRight_ms);
        iHealthySensorCount  := 3;
        wAlarmWord.1         := FALSE; (* Clear TMR divergence warning *)
    ELSIF (rDelta_Laser_Left <= rTmrTolerance_ms) AND (rDelta_Laser_Right > rTmrTolerance_ms) THEN
        (* Right wheel is slipping or encoder channel 3 faulty -> Isolate Right encoder *)
        rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := (0.65 * rLaserDistVelocity_ms) + (0.35 * rWheelEncoderLeft_ms);
        bSensorRight_Valid   := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
        wAlarmWord.1         := TRUE;  (* Sensor divergence warning *)
    ELSIF (rDelta_Laser_Right <= rTmrTolerance_ms) AND (rDelta_Laser_Left > rTmrTolerance_ms) THEN
        (* Left wheel is slipping or encoder channel 2 faulty -> Isolate Left encoder *)
        rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := (0.65 * rLaserDistVelocity_ms) + (0.35 * rWheelEncoderRight_ms);
        bSensorLeft_Valid    := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
        wAlarmWord.1         := TRUE;  (* Sensor divergence warning *)
    ELSIF (rDelta_Left_Right <= rTmrTolerance_ms) AND (rDelta_Laser_Left > rTmrTolerance_ms) THEN
        (* Optical laser dropout (lens dust / rail gap) -> Rely on dual wheel encoders *)
        rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := (rWheelEncoderLeft_ms + rWheelEncoderRight_ms) * 0.50;
        bSensorLaser_Valid   := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
        wAlarmWord.1         := TRUE;  (* Laser sensor dropout alert *)
    ELSE
        (* Total TMR Asynchrony: High slip on both wheels simultaneously during aggressive acceleration *)
        rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := rLaserDistVelocity_ms; (* Optical Doppler is immune to mechanical wheel slip *)
        iHealthySensorCount  := 1;
        wAlarmWord.1         := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;  (* Severe Kinematic Incoherence Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bSensorLaser_Valid AND (bSensorLeft_Valid OR bSensorRight_Valid) THEN
    (* 2oo2 degraded voting mode *)
    IF bSensorLeft_Valid THEN
        rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := (0.70 * rLaserDistVelocity_ms) + (0.30 * rWheelEncoderLeft_ms);
    ELSE
        rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := (0.70 * rLaserDistVelocity_ms) + (0.30 * rWheelEncoderRight_ms);
    END_IF;
    iHealthySensorCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.1        := TRUE;
ELSIF bSensorLaser_Valid THEN
    (* 1oo1 single-channel laser operation *)
    rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := rLaserDistVelocity_ms;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 1;
    wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;
ELSIF bSensorLeft_Valid AND bSensorRight_Valid THEN
    (* Dual wheel encoders only: Subject to common-mode slip *)
    rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := (rWheelEncoderLeft_ms + rWheelEncoderRight_ms) * 0.50;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total sensor loss: Safe zero speed fallback *)
    rVotedGroundSpeed_ms := 0.0;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 0;
    wAlarmWord.3         := TRUE;  (* Critical Sensor Blackout Alarm *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: WHEEL SLIP CALCULATION & ANTI-SLIP ADHESION ESTIMATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Normalized Slip Ratio for Left and Right Driven Wheels *)
IF ABS(rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) > 0.08 THEN
    rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio  := (rWheelEncoderLeft_ms - rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) / ABS(rVotedGroundSpeed_ms);
    rWheelSlipRight_Ratio := (rWheelEncoderRight_ms - rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) / ABS(rVotedGroundSpeed_ms);
ELSE
    (* Low speed regime near zero velocity: Normalize by mechanical wheel surface velocity *)
    IF ABS(rWheelEncoderLeft_ms) > 0.05 THEN
        rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio := (rWheelEncoderLeft_ms - rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) / ABS(rWheelEncoderLeft_ms);
    ELSE
        rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF ABS(rWheelEncoderRight_ms) > 0.05 THEN
        rWheelSlipRight_Ratio := (rWheelEncoderRight_ms - rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) / ABS(rWheelEncoderRight_ms);
    ELSE
        rWheelSlipRight_Ratio := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Rail Adhesion Coefficient Estimation via IMU Acceleration Observer *)
IF ABS(rImuAccel_X_ms2) > 0.15 AND rTotalShuttleMass_kg > 50.0 THEN
    rEstimatedAdhesion_mu := (rTotalShuttleMass_kg * ABS(rImuAccel_X_ms2)) / (rTotalShuttleMass_kg * 9.80665);
    (* Low-pass filter the adhesion estimate *)
    rAdhesionFilter_mu    := (0.92 * rAdhesionFilter_mu) + (0.08 * rEstimatedAdhesion_mu);
ELSE
    rAdhesionFilter_mu    := (0.98 * rAdhesionFilter_mu) + (0.02 * rRailFrictionNominal_mu);
END_IF;

(* Clamp adhesion filter within physically plausible polyurethane-steel limits *)
IF rAdhesionFilter_mu < 0.12 THEN
    rAdhesionFilter_mu := 0.12;
ELSIF rAdhesionFilter_mu > 0.75 THEN
    rAdhesionFilter_mu := 0.75;
END_IF;

(* Available Maximum Longitudinal Tractive Force Before Wheel Spin *)
rMaxTractionForce_N := rAdhesionFilter_mu * rTotalShuttleMass_kg * 9.80665;

(* Slip Detection Evaluation *)
IF (ABS(rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio) > rSlipThreshold_Warning) OR (ABS(rWheelSlipRight_Ratio) > rSlipThreshold_Warning) THEN
    bTractionSlipActive       := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.4              := TRUE; (* Wheel Slip Alert *)
    udiSlipInterventionsCount := udiSlipInterventionsCount + 1;
ELSE
    bTractionSlipActive       := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.4              := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: SUPERCAPACITOR ELECTROCHEMICAL STATE-OF-CHARGE & THERMAL MANAGEMENT
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Coulomb Counting with Open-Circuit Voltage Polarization Correction *)
rCoulombCounter_As := rCoulombCounter_As - (rSupercapCurrent_A * 0.005);
IF rCoulombCounter_As < 0.0 THEN
    rCoulombCounter_As := 0.0;
ELSIF rCoulombCounter_As > (rCapacitance_F * 96.0) THEN
    rCoulombCounter_As := (rCapacitance_F * 96.0);
END_IF;

(* State-of-Charge Calculation [%] based on terminal voltage corrected for IR drop *)
rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct := ((rSupercapVoltage_V + (rSupercapCurrent_A * rSupercapESR_Ohm) - 48.0) / (96.0 - 48.0)) * 100.0;
IF rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct := 0.0;
ELSIF rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Thermal Throttling: Linear current derating between 55.0 deg C and 65.0 deg C *)
IF rSupercapCellMaxTemp_DegC > 65.0 THEN
    rDynamicCurrentLimit_A := 0.0;   (* Hard thermal cutoff *)
    wAlarmWord.5           := TRUE;  (* Supercap Overtemperature Trip *)
ELSIF rSupercapCellMaxTemp_DegC > 55.0 THEN
    rDynamicCurrentLimit_A := 300.0 * (1.0 - ((rSupercapCellMaxTemp_DegC - 55.0) / 10.0));
    wAlarmWord.5           := TRUE;  (* Supercap Thermal Derating Warning *)
ELSE
    rDynamicCurrentLimit_A := 300.0; (* Full in-motion charging capacity *)
    wAlarmWord.5           := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE TRACTION CONTROL & ACCELERATION VECTORING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State Tracking Errors *)
rState_x0_PosErr := rTargetPosition_m - (rTargetPosition_m); (* Position tracking differential *)
rState_x1_VelErr := rTargetVelocity_ms - rVotedGroundSpeed_ms;
rState_x2_VelErrInt := rState_x2_VelErrInt + (rState_x1_VelErr * 0.005);

(* Anti-windup clamping on velocity error integral *)
IF rState_x2_VelErrInt > 1.20 THEN
    rState_x2_VelErrInt := 1.20;
ELSIF rState_x2_VelErrInt < -1.20 THEN
    rState_x2_VelErrInt := -1.20;
END_IF;

rState_x3_SocErr := rSoC_Target_Pct - rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct;

(* Receding Horizon MPC Force Calculation: Feedforward Target Acceleration + State Feedback *)
rPredictedForce_N := (rTotalShuttleMass_kg * rTargetAcceleration_ms2)
                   + (rGain_VelD * rState_x1_VelErr)
                   + (rGain_VelI * rState_x2_VelErrInt);

(* Adhesion Boundary Enforcement (Anti-Spin Saturation) *)
IF rPredictedForce_N > rMaxTractionForce_N THEN
    rTractionForceTotal_N := rMaxTractionForce_N;
ELSIF rPredictedForce_N < -rMaxTractionForce_N THEN
    rTractionForceTotal_N := -rMaxTractionForce_N;
ELSE
    rTractionForceTotal_N := rPredictedForce_N;
END_IF;

(* Differential Anti-Slip Torque Vectoring Between Left and Right Wheels *)
IF bTractionSlipActive THEN
    (* Allocate more torque to the wheel with superior adhesion, derating the slipping wheel *)
    rTorqueVectorBias_Nm := (rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio - rWheelSlipRight_Ratio) * 18.5;
    (* Clamp torque vectoring bias to avoid mechanical yaw instability *)
    IF rTorqueVectorBias_Nm > 12.0 THEN
        rTorqueVectorBias_Nm := 12.0;
    ELSIF rTorqueVectorBias_Nm < -12.0 THEN
        rTorqueVectorBias_Nm := -12.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTorqueVectorBias_Nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 6: FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 MODULAR SHUTTLE DISPATCH)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_BOOT_CALIBRATION: Power-up, self-test & contact shoe retraction *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bTractionSlipActive     := FALSE;
        bFastChargeActive       := FALSE;
        bDegradedMode           := FALSE;
        rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm       := 0.0;
        rTorqueCmdRight_Nm      := 0.0;
        rChargeCurrentCmd_A     := 0.0;
        rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct := 0.0; (* Mechanical brake engaged for safety *)
        wStatusWord             := 16#0001;

        tonStartupDelay(IN := bMasterEnable, PT := T#2500MS);
        IF tonStartupDelay.Q THEN
            tonStartupDelay(IN := FALSE);
            IF (rSupercapVoltage_V >= 45.0) AND (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Proceed to Standby Parked *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord.6 := TRUE; (* Insufficient Supercap Voltage or Sensor Fault *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_PARKED: Mechanical holding brake energized, zero motion *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bDegradedMode           := (iHealthySensorCount < 3);
        bFastChargeActive       := FALSE;
        rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm       := 0.0;
        rTorqueCmdRight_Nm      := 0.0;
        rChargeCurrentCmd_A     := 0.0;
        rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct := 0.0; (* Brake clamped holding position *)
        wStatusWord             := 16#0010;

        IF bMasterEnable AND bAutoModeSelect THEN
            IF ABS(rTargetVelocity_ms) > 0.05 THEN
                iState := 20; (* Dispatch to Active High-Speed Motion *)
            ELSIF bChargeShoeContactActive AND (rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct < rSoC_Target_Pct) THEN
                iState := 30; (* Stationary Fast Charging *)
            END_IF;
        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_TRACTION_MPC_DISPATCH: High-speed closed-loop cruise with anti-slip vectoring *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bDegradedMode           := (iHealthySensorCount < 3);
        rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct := 100.0; (* Release mechanical brake completely *)
        wStatusWord             := 16#0020;

        (* Convert total tractive force to motor shaft torques with differential anti-slip vectoring *)
        rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm  := (0.50 * rTractionForceTotal_N * (rWheelRadius_m / rGearRatio)) - rTorqueVectorBias_Nm;
        rTorqueCmdRight_Nm := (0.50 * rTractionForceTotal_N * (rWheelRadius_m / rGearRatio)) + rTorqueVectorBias_Nm;

        (* Clamp torque outputs to drive peak limits (+/- 42.0 Nm) *)
        IF rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm > 42.0 THEN
            rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm := 42.0;
        ELSIF rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm < -42.0 THEN
            rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm := -42.0;
        END_IF;

        IF rTorqueCmdRight_Nm > 42.0 THEN
            rTorqueCmdRight_Nm := 42.0;
        ELSIF rTorqueCmdRight_Nm < -42.0 THEN
            rTorqueCmdRight_Nm := -42.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Accumulate mechanical traction energy *)
        rCumulativeTractionWork_kJ := rCumulativeTractionWork_kJ + (ABS(rTractionForceTotal_N * rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) * 0.005 * 0.001);

        (* Check for In-Motion Fast Charging Sector Encounter *)
        IF bChargeRailZoneApproach AND bChargeShoeContactActive AND (rChargingRailBusVoltage_V > 80.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Seamless transition to in-motion charging *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio) > rSlipThreshold_Critical) OR (ABS(rWheelSlipRight_Ratio) > rSlipThreshold_Critical) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Severe wheel spin: Transition to active slip recovery *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) < 0.03) AND (ABS(rTargetVelocity_ms) < 0.01) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Mission complete: Return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_IN_MOTION_FAST_CHARGE: High-speed simultaneous motion and supercapacitor charging *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bFastChargeActive       := TRUE;
        bDegradedMode           := (iHealthySensorCount < 3);
        rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct := 100.0;
        wStatusWord             := 16#0030;

        (* Closed-loop traction continues unperturbed during in-motion charging *)
        rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm  := (0.50 * rTractionForceTotal_N * (rWheelRadius_m / rGearRatio)) - rTorqueVectorBias_Nm;
        rTorqueCmdRight_Nm := (0.50 * rTractionForceTotal_N * (rWheelRadius_m / rGearRatio)) + rTorqueVectorBias_Nm;

        (* Fast-charging current regulation (CC/CV Profile with Thermal Throttling) *)
        IF (rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct < 88.0) THEN
            (* Constant Current (CC) Phase: Maximum allowable current bounded by thermal derating *)
            rChargeCurrentCmd_A := rDynamicCurrentLimit_A;
        ELSIF (rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct < 98.0) THEN
            (* Constant Voltage (CV) Phase: Current tapers linearly as target voltage is approached *)
            rChargeCurrentCmd_A := rDynamicCurrentLimit_A * ((98.0 - rEstimatedStateOfCharge_Pct) / 10.0);
        ELSE
            (* Float Charge / Trickle cutoff *)
            rChargeCurrentCmd_A := 5.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Accumulate ingested electrical energy *)
        rCumulativeEnergyCharged_Wh := rCumulativeEnergyCharged_Wh + (rChargingRailBusVoltage_V * rChargeCurrentCmd_A * (0.005 / 3600.0));

        (* Predictive Departure De-energization: Ramp down current before shoe leaves conductor rail *)
        IF NOT bChargeRailZoneApproach THEN
            rChargeCurrentCmd_A := 0.0; (* Arc suppression instant quench *)
            bFastChargeActive   := FALSE;
            iState              := 20;  (* Return to standard cruise *)
        ELSIF NOT bChargeShoeContactActive THEN
            rChargeCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
            bFastChargeActive   := FALSE;
            wAlarmWord.7        := TRUE; (* Premature shoe bounce warning *)
            iState              := 20;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_SLIP_RECOVERY_VECTORING: Emergency traction loss recovery and rail re-adhesion *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bTractionSlipActive     := TRUE;
        bDegradedMode           := TRUE;
        rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct := 100.0;
        wStatusWord             := 16#0040;
        wAlarmWord.8            := TRUE; (* Active Adhesion Recovery Intervention *)

        (* Aggressive torque reduction (75% derating) to allow polyurethane wheel to regain static friction *)
        rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm  := (0.125 * rTractionForceTotal_N * (rWheelRadius_m / rGearRatio)) - (rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio * 25.0);
        rTorqueCmdRight_Nm := (0.125 * rTractionForceTotal_N * (rWheelRadius_m / rGearRatio)) - (rWheelSlipRight_Ratio * 25.0);

        tonSlipLatching(IN := (ABS(rWheelSlipLeft_Ratio) < rSlipThreshold_Warning) AND (ABS(rWheelSlipRight_Ratio) < rSlipThreshold_Warning), PT := T#120MS);
        IF tonSlipLatching.Q THEN
            tonSlipLatching(IN := FALSE);
            wAlarmWord.8 := FALSE;
            iState       := 20; (* Adhesion restored: Resume normal trajectory *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_DEGRADED_LIMP_HOME: Severe sensor loss or high thermal strain creep mode *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bDegradedMode           := TRUE;
        bFastChargeActive       := FALSE;
        rChargeCurrentCmd_A     := 0.0;
        rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct := 100.0;
        wStatusWord             := 16#0050;
        wAlarmWord.9            := TRUE; (* Limp Home Degraded Mode Active *)

        (* Limit speed strictly to 0.80 m/s with gentle torque ramp *)
        IF rVotedGroundSpeed_ms > 0.80 THEN
            rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm  := -5.0;
            rTorqueCmdRight_Nm := -5.0;
        ELSE
            rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm  := 4.0;
            rTorqueCmdRight_Nm := 4.0;
        END_IF;

        IF (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND (rSupercapCellMaxTemp_DegC < 50.0) AND bAutoModeSelect THEN
            wAlarmWord.9 := FALSE;
            iState       := 10; (* Recovered: Return to standby *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_SAFETY_TRIP_DYNAMIC_BRAKE: Critical hardware trip or e-stop actuation *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bTractionSlipActive     := FALSE;
        bFastChargeActive       := FALSE;
        bDegradedMode           := FALSE;
        rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm       := 0.0;
        rTorqueCmdRight_Nm      := 0.0;
        rChargeCurrentCmd_A     := 0.0;
        rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct := 0.0;   (* Mechanical spring brake applied immediately *)
        rTractionForceTotal_N   := 0.0;
        wStatusWord             := 16#9999;
        wAlarmWord.10           := TRUE;  (* Subsystem Tripped Safe Stop *)

        IF bSafetyRelayOk AND (ABS(rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) < 0.02) AND NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            wAlarmWord.10 := FALSE;
            iState        := 0; (* Reset sequence *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 7: ISA-18.2 SECONDARY SAFETY SUPERVISION & STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY INTERLOCKS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Supercapacitor Overvoltage Protection (Rail Transient Spike > 102.0 V) *)
IF rSupercapVoltage_V > 102.0 THEN
    rChargeCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord.11       := TRUE; (* EDLC Overvoltage Trip *)
    iState              := 99;   (* Trip system to protect dielectric integrity *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.11       := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Critical Low Voltage Deep-Discharge Lockout (< 42.0 V) *)
IF rSupercapVoltage_V < 42.0 AND (iState <> 0) AND (iState <> 99) THEN
    wAlarmWord.12 := TRUE; (* Severe Under-Voltage Brownout *)
    iState        := 50;   (* Force into degraded low-power state *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.12 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Mechanical Brake Release Fault Detection *)
IF (rMechanicalBrakeCmd_Pct > 50.0) AND (ABS(rImuAccel_X_ms2) < 0.05) AND (ABS(rTorqueCmdLeft_Nm) > 25.0) AND (ABS(rVotedGroundSpeed_ms) < 0.01) THEN
    wAlarmWord.13 := TRUE; (* Potential Brake Drag / Locked Wheel Alert *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.13 := FALSE;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
